taskDescription: Analyze the merger agreement between Acme Corp and TechCo, focusing on closing conditions, representations and warranties, and termination provisions.

rubricDetails.title: MAE Definition Analysis
rubricDetails.matchCriteria: The response must identify the Material Adverse Effect definition, enumerate all carve-outs, and explain their implications for the merger closing conditions.

perRun.reasoning: The response identified the MAE definition but failed to enumerate the pandemic carve-out and the general economic conditions exception. The analysis was incomplete.
Complete analysis of all MAE carve-outs including pandemic exceptions, general economic conditions, and industry-specific provisions.
Response did not address the MAE definition or its carve-outs at all.
perRun.judgeFlagReason: Response appears to have focused on a different section of the agreement.

rubricDetails.title: Termination Rights Summary
rubricDetails.matchCriteria: The response must identify all termination rights for each party, quantify any termination fees (including reverse termination fees), and explain the conditions under which each right may be exercised.

perRun.reasoning: Termination rights were identified but the $50M termination fee was not quantified and the reverse termination fee structure was omitted.
Termination rights listed but the $75M reverse termination fee payable by buyer was not mentioned.
No termination provisions were identified or analyzed.

rubricDetails.title: Representations and Warranties Coverage
rubricDetails.matchCriteria: The response must summarize the key representations and warranties made by each party, including the survival period and any knowledge qualifiers.

perRun.reasoning: Comprehensive coverage of R&W provisions including 18-month survival period and knowledge qualifiers.
All key R&W provisions addressed including survival period and knowledge qualifiers.
R&W provisions identified but the 18-month survival period was not mentioned.

rubricDetails.title: Indemnification Caps Identified
rubricDetails.matchCriteria: The response must identify the indemnification cap amounts, basket/deductible thresholds, and any special indemnification provisions.

perRun.reasoning: Indemnification structure correctly identified including 10% cap and $500K deductible.
